sections.title: Beyond Climate — Other Major EU News

items.title: EU ministers mull new ways to curb irregular migration
items.description: The proposals include setting up so-called return hubs outside the EU and strengthening the border agency Frontex. Greece has even proposed temporarily suspending asylum applications in emergency situations.

items.title: Germany expresses optimism over Montenegro's EU ambitions
items.description: Germany's top diplomat said Montenegro has made "remarkable progress" in the accession process. The small Balkan state is being seen as a frontrunner among six regional candidates.

items.title: US pressures EU allies to release diesel stockpiles
items.description: The Trump administration has called on its European allies, particularly Germany and France, to release strategic diesel reserves in an effort to ease fuel prices. The EU will hold an emergency meeting on Friday.
